items.title: Pete Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: Judy Garland, Ella Fitzgerald, Peggy Lee, wow.

ctx.x: What an orchestrator. I mean he is such a good composer that you don’t need a time, a clock to catch a cue. If you played naturally, like it’s written, it falls, that’s it. He’s just one of those people. And anybody that writes like this, they don’t use a C trumpet instead of a B flat trumpet, and write like it’s a B flat trumpet. There’s a difference in quality between the C. See it has a different edge, a different pitch. Good composers will know that and use it and write in the right register for that so it…
Judy Garland, Ella Fitzgerald, Peggy Lee, wow. How long do we have here, right? But now—
Just let me, I’m talking too much.
